subject: Cloud listing: evidence pack & onboarding pathway (AWS/Azure/GCP)
messages:
From: CloudProcure RFP <rfp@cloudprocure.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: marketplace-onboarding@aws.amazon.com
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing request: evidence pack & intake form

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. We're starting the intake for CloudProcure Inc's third-party listing evaluation across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Attached is the formal request and the intake checklist we'll use to validate technical, security, and commercial eligibility. For Redwood, the intake items we require initially are:

- Contact and billing PO details
- Public product description and screenshots (desktop + mobile)
- Tenant isolation and data flow diagrams (high level)
- SOC 2 / security certifications and any third-party pen test reports
- Sample procurement/contracting terms and proposed marketplace pricing model
- Onboarding timeline with named owners and expected lead times

Can you confirm whether you can provide the evidence pack by next Wednesday (2027-04-21)? If there are items scoped to Legal (contracts), Security (certs), or Product (diagrams) we can accept partial uploads and move forward while you complete the rest.

Attachments: marketplace_intake_checklist_v2.pdf (form), initial_requirements.xlsx

Best,
Tara Nguyen
Vendor Onboarding Manager
CloudProcure Inc
rfp@cloudprocure.com

--- ORIGINAL NOTE: Please escalate any contract exceptions to the marketplace team in parallel to avoid delays.---

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: CloudProcure RFP <rfp@cloudprocure.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing request: evidence pack & intake form

Tara,

Thanks — happy to take the lead on this on Redwood's side. We can provide a staged evidence pack to meet your timeline. Quick summary of what we'll deliver and owners: 

1) Security & compliance artifacts (owner: Karthik Iyer) — SOC 2 Type II report, penetration test summary, data handling statement.
2) Product & architecture artifacts (owner: Irene Choi) — high-level tenant isolation diagram, flow for API calls, sample config for private deployment.
3) Commercial & procurement (owner: Marissa Cole) — proposed marketplace SKU definitions, pricing matrix, and PO/contact details.

Proposed schedule (attached): initial upload with core security certs + product screenshots by 2027-04-21; full technical annex and contract redlines by 2027-04-29. If that works for CloudProcure, we'll start assembling the artifacts today.

I've attached our draft evidence packet (redwood_marketplace_evidence_v1.pdf), the onboarding timeline (onboarding_timeline.xlsx), and a short security annex draft (security-annex-answers.docx). Please confirm which items are accepted as "sufficient evidence" for the intake so we can prioritize.

Also: two quick clarifications from Karthik (cc'd) that will shape the annex: 
- Do you require raw pen-test reports or is an executive summary sufficient?
- For multi-tenant hosted offering, do you need isolation-by-customer architecture diagrams for dedicated and private deployment variants or only the hosted variant?

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_marketplace_evidence_v1.pdf, onboarding_timeline.xlsx, security-annex-answers.docx

----
Irene Choi
Head of Platform Partnerships | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Marketplace listing request: evidence pack & intake form

Irene / Marissa — quick internal notes as I review the intake: 

- Pen test: we have a recent full report but it contains customer redactions. Suggest we provide an executive summary + timeboxed access to the full report under NDA if the marketplace requires it. That should satisfy most marketplace teams while preserving customer confidentiality.
- Tenant isolation: our hosted API and private (VPC/on-prem) variants differ. For initial intake, provide the hosted isolation diagram and an appendix that lists differences for Dedicated/Private. The marketplace typically only requires the hosted topology unless the listing will include private options.
- Billing/pricing: Marissa, we'll need to map our SKU definitions to marketplace product IDs (metering units). Recommend we include both per-token and bundle SKU examples and a suggested list price with standard revenue share assumptions.
- Legal/terms: If CloudProcure insists on marketplace-procured PO terms, we should flag any pass-through liability changes. Marissa, can you draft the minimal acceptable contract exceptions?

I'll slot time with Security to redact the pen test and prepare the summary. ETA for the polished annex: 2027-04-28.

-Karthik
Senior Security & Compliance Manager

From: CloudProcure RFP <rfp@cloudprocure.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: marketplace-onboarding@aws.amazon.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing request: evidence pack & intake form

Irene, Karthik — thanks for the clear plan and the draft packet. Confirming the staged approach is fine. A few notes from the intake team: 

- Executive summary for the pen-test is acceptable at intake; we will request a limited-access copy once the listing moves to verification.
- Hosted topology + appendix covering Dedicated/Private is sufficient for the three marketplaces. Please label diagrams clearly with version and date.
- For pricing: please include one sample SKU mapped to a monthly metering unit and an indicative price. We'll use that as the sample listing while the marketplace product ID is minted.

Action items we need from Redwood by 2027-04-21:
1) redwood_marketplace_evidence_v1.pdf (core certs + product screenshots) — ACCEPTED
2) onboarding_timeline.xlsx (named owners + milestones) — ACCEPTED
3) security-annex-answers.docx — Please expand to include the executive pen-test summary and sign-off by your security lead.

We'll open a DocuSign for the marketplace listing agreement once the technical verification completes (link: https://docusign.net/abc123). If anything causes a slip beyond 2027-04-29, loop me directly so we can rebase the marketplace intake queue.

Best,
Tara Nguyen
Vendor Onboarding Manager
CloudProcure Inc
Attachments: intake_acknowledgement.pdf

---
Note: marketplace-onboarding@aws.amazon.com requested a short video walkthrough of the seller console as optional supplemental material; if you can produce a 5–7 minute screen capture highlighting SKU creation and metering, it will speed verification. ---
